Create a basic response using the Responses API

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateResponseRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = CreateResponseRequest.from_json("{\"input\":\"Explain quantum computing in one sentence.\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\"}")
    result = await client.create_response(request)
    print(result.id)
    print(result.status)
    print(result.output)

asyncio.run(main())
```
